articles.title: Court Rulings Spark a Redistricting Frenzy Across the South
articles.summary: A Virginia Supreme Court ruling nullified a voter-approved redistricting plan, while Southern Republicans seized on a U.S. Supreme Court decision to redraw maps. The moves could give the GOP a 10-seat advantage, reshaping the battle for the House.

articles.title: Southern States Rush to Redraw Maps After Supreme Court Ruling
articles.summary: Following a U.S. Supreme Court decision that weakened voting rights protections, GOP-led states are swiftly redrawing congressional districts. Tennessee enacted a map dismantling its only Democratic seat, while Alabama and South Carolina push for partisan gains.

articles.title: Iran Elevates Strait of Hormuz to 'Atomic Bomb' Level in U.S. Talks
articles.summary: As negotiations with Washington continue, Iranian officials are framing control of the Strait of Hormuz as a strategic asset on par with a nuclear weapon. The waterway, vital for global oil transit, is being touted as leverage against U.S. sanctions.
